name: Tarek
headline: All About Me
blurb: I am Tarek, and this is a little snapshot of who I am. I am a student, a growing person, and someone who is always learning and trying to improve every day.
photoBlurb: I am currently a student at Susan E. Wagner High School, and I have an identical twin brother. I am a sophomore graduating in 2029.
